name: Royal Wheels Travels
tagline: Premium Bus & Coach Rentals with Professional Drivers
shortAbout: We provide premium, comfortable, and reliable bus rentals for local and outstation journeys across India. Every booking includes a verified, experienced chauffeur.
fullAbout: Founded with a vision to redefine group travel, Royal Wheels Travels delivers punctual, hygienic, and luxurious transportation for families, corporations, schools, and tour groups. With a modern fleet ranging from 17-seater luxury minibuses to 55-seater executive air-conditioned coaches, we ensure every mile is safe, comfortable, and memorable.
philosophy: Your safety, comfort, and peace of mind are our highest priorities. We treat every traveler like royalty.
safetyPromise: All our vehicles undergo multi-point safety inspections before departure, feature GPS tracking, speed governors, emergency exits, and are piloted by certified chauffeurs with over 7+ years of highway experience.
address: Shop 12-14, Imperial Commercial Complex, Ring Road
workingHours: 24/7 Operations & Road Assistance (Booking Desk: 7:00 AM - 11:00 PM)
